title: PM Motion Optimization Loop (self-learning)
description: Self-learning lint → edit → verify → learn cycle for optimizing Figma Motion timelines against the production Polymarket app kit (pm-app-motion). Deterministic linter (motion-lint.mjs) scores springs/durations/tracks against the damping census and timing laws; edits via use_figma; cheap export_video verification; every run appends verified findings to LEARNINGS.md so the next run starts smarter.
